findings.suggestion: End on the useful conclusion; keep a summary when readers need one.
findings.why: A generic closing announcement may repeat rather than complete the argument.
findings.fix: End at the useful conclusion if the announcement is unnecessary.
findings.keep_when: Keep summaries in reports and teaching material where readers need a recap.
